# Short block near the bottom

**[F1]** The second column of the table lists the standard error for each estimate. This section explains why the simple linear fit is adequate for the present purpose. The measured response follows the predicted curve closely across the full range of inputs. Small deviations appear near the boundary, where the approximation is known to weaken. We therefore repeat the experiment with a finer grid and a longer settling time. Each sample is weighed twice, and the mean of the two readings is recorded.

**[F2]** Reviewers asked for a clearer statement of the assumptions behind the model. In practice the correction is small, but it matters for the final uncertainty budget.
